old.task: Order a 2 kg chocolate birthday cake for Saturday, with the message 'Happy 7th, Amani', for pickup.
old.summary: I filled in and submitted the custom cake form at /custom-cakes/, but the site did not confirm the order. After I clicked "Send my order request", the page only showed "Nothing here yet." There was no confirmation message or order number. The form had these values: name Wanjiru Kamau, phone +254 700 000 007, collection date 14/11/2026, size 2 kg (KES 6,500), flavour Chocolate fudge, message "Message on cake: Happy 7th, Amani. Birthday cake, for pickup. Email: wanjiru.kamau@example.com". The form has no email field, so I put the email in the message box. The form also has no pickup/delivery option, so I wrote "for pickup" in the message. Earlier I pressed Enter while the Size dropdown was focused, which may have submitted the form once with the default 1 kg size and no message. I can't confirm whether either submission was received. The site says it confirms orders by phone within one working day and takes a 50% deposit.
